name: TP-RAG
description: TP-RAG is a benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented large language model agents in spatiotemporal-aware travel planning. It includes real-world travel queries, annotated points of interest, and high-quality travel trajectories to assess models on route efficiency, POI appeal, and real-time adaptability.
reputation: A very recent benchmark for travel-planning agents that is not yet broadly established in the community.
notes: Includes 2,348 queries, 85,575 annotated POIs, and 18,784 travel trajectories; focuses on spatiotemporal rationality and travel plan quality.
